sessions.about: a whole match, first to 2: lobby, settings, ready, start, rounds, hovers, clock checks, telemetry
B drops mid-round with an echo still in flight, keeps playing offline, reconnects: queued moves are resent and land once, the one the server already had is not
B drops long enough to freeze, restarts the app and rejoins, a remake vote passes; A reconnects, asks for a resync, and has a move refused
B's line dies silently; B plays on offline for 5s; the battle holds; B is back at 12s, nothing snaps back, 3-2-1, the remake declined
B never comes back: after the 30s hold A claims, B forfeits the match
